name: Scheduler
description:
An events calendar for planning: maintenance windows, bookings and shifts. Month, week, day
and agenda views share a header with previous, next, Today, the visible range and a view
switch. Overlapping events sit side by side; all-day and multi-day events run as bars in a
band above the hours, and a month cell that overflows offers "+N more". The grid is drawn in
the browser's zone or `timeZone`. Click or drag over empty time to select a slot; with
`editable`, drag events to move them, drag their lower edge to resize, or focus one and use
the arrow keys (Shift for the end). In a narrow container the week shows one day with a day
strip and the month shows dots with the selected day's events below. It fills its
container's height; give it one (a Panel body, a sized region).
signature: <E extends SchedulerEvent = SchedulerEvent>({ events, view: viewProp, defaultView, onViewChange, views, date: dateProp, defaultDate, onDateChange, timeZone: zoneProp, locale: localeProp, weekStartsOn, now: nowProp, loading, editable, snapMinutes, slotMinutes, scrollToTime, onEventClick, onSlotSelect, onEventChange, resources, compact: compactProp, labels, className, style, "aria-label": ariaLabel, }: SchedulerProps<E>): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name for the whole scheduler. Default the visible range.

props.name: className
props.description: Layout only.

props.name: compact
props.description: Force the compact form (one day column, dots in the month) on or off. Default: by the container's width.

props.name: date
props.description: A day in the range shown (controlled): the month, week or day around it.

props.name: defaultDate
props.description: The first day shown when uncontrolled. Default today in `timeZone`.

props.name: defaultView
props.description: The first view when uncontrolled. Default "week".

props.name: editable
props.description: Let people move and resize events by dragging and with the keyboard. A function decides per event.

props.name: events
props.description: The events to show. Keep the array stable between renders; a new array drops optimistic changes the host has not kept.

props.name: labels
props.type: Partial<{ readonly views: "View"; readonly month: "Month"; readonly week: "Week"; readonly day: "Day"; readonly agenda: "Agenda"; readonly today: "Today"; readonly previous: (view: SchedulerView) => string; readonly next: (view: SchedulerView) => string; readonly allDay: "All day"; readonly more: (count: number) => string; readonly moreLabel: (count: number, day: string) => string; readonly dayLabel: (day: string, count: number) => string; readonly timeRange: (start: string, end: string) => string; readonly eventLabel: (title: string, when: string, resource?: string) => string; readonly editHint: "Arrow keys move it, Shift and arrow keys change its end, Enter opens it"; readonly slots: (day: string) => string; readonly slotsHint: "Arrow keys choose a time, Shift and arrow keys extend it, Enter selects it"; readonly slotFocused: (when: string) => string; readonly moved: (title: string, when: string) => string; readonly resized: (title: string, when: string) => string; readonly changeFailed: (title: string) => string; readonly noEvents: "No events"; readonly noEventsIn: (range: string) => string; readonly agendaLabel: (range: string) => string; readonly loading: "Loading events"; readonly now: (time: string) => string; readonly weekDays: "Days of the week"; readonly continues: "continues"; }> | undefined
props.description: Replace any of the wording (see `schedulerMessages`).

props.name: loading
props.description: Events are loading: the grid keeps its geometry and shows placeholders where events go.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale for names, times and the first day of the week. Default the nearest `LocaleProvider`, then `configureLocale()`, then `<html lang>`.

props.name: now
props.description: The current time, for today and the time line. Default the clock, updated each minute.

props.name: onDateChange
props.description: Called with the new day when the person moves with previous, next, Today or a day's heading.

props.name: onEventChange
props.description:
Called when the person moves or resizes an event. The event shows at its new time at
once; update `events` to keep it there. Return a promise to hold it there until it
settles: a rejection puts it back and announces that the change failed.

props.name: onEventClick
props.type: ((event: E, details: { element: HTMLElement; }) => void) | undefined
props.description: Called when the person opens an event (click, tap or Enter).

props.name: onSlotSelect
props.description: Called with an empty stretch of time chosen by click, drag or keyboard. Without it, empty time cannot be selected.

props.name: onViewChange
props.description: Called with the view the person switches to, or "day" when they open a day's heading.

props.name: resources
props.description: Resources named on events by `resourceId`.

props.name: scrollToTime
props.description: The time of day the week and day views scroll to when they open ("07:00"). Default "07:00".

props.name: slotMinutes
props.description: Minutes in one slot of the time grid: its lines and what a click selects. Default 30.

props.name: snapMinutes
props.description: Minutes that drags and arrow keys snap to. Default 15.

props.name: style
props.description: Layout only.

props.name: timeZone
props.description: The IANA zone whose wall clock the grid shows ("Australia/Sydney"). Default the browser's.

props.name: view
props.description: The view shown (controlled).

props.name: views
props.description: The views in the switch, in order. Default month, week, day and agenda.

props.name: weekStartsOn
props.description: First day of the week, 1 = Monday … 7 = Sunday. Default the locale's.
